title: GeNN Spiking Neural Network Framework
summary: GeNN is a software package designed to accelerate simulations of spiking neural networks (SNNs) primarily on NVIDIA GPUs. It utilizes code generation with backends including C++/CUDA for GPU and C++ for CPU-only execution, supporting Linux, Windows, and MacOS. Networks are defined via a Python API using GeNNCode strings to customize neurons, synapses, plasticity, and connectivity. The framework supports large-scale models containing millions of neurons and billions of synapses on a single device by offloading initialization and generating connectivity dynamically. Applications range from simulating cortical models to training recurrent SNNs for machine learning tasks.
tldr: GeNN is a flexible software package accelerating spiking neural network simulations on GPUs via code generation and customizable components.
evidence: GeNN is a software package to accelerate Spiking Neural Network simulations on hardware including NVIDIA GPUs.
The main backends are currently C++/CUDA for NVIDIA GPUs or C++ for CPU-only mode.
